basis: Follow-up to preserved FD2-TTC-VALIDATION-v2 FAIL. User specified note speed stays fixed during a map; each speed is a separate map-like run with a fresh estimator.
claim_boundary: Frozen-policy timing transfer over constant pre-map speeds only; does not claim adaptation to mid-map speed changes or full-chart play.
cases: EA13 learning-on receipt seeds 907, 1009, 1103; two exact repeated traces per seed and speed; matched untrained seed 907 is silent at 1x.
pass: All 30 learning-on traces emit exactly one lane-0 DOWN within +/-73.5ms of note contact, followed by one UP exactly 10ms later; repeats match exactly; weights unchanged; untrained control is silent.
